webster.text: Impropriety of behavior; that in behavior or manners which violates the established rules of civility, or the duties of respect which age or station requires; an unbecoming action.

example.quote: there is a seeming indecorum in such power, which leads me to propose a change.
example.cite: James Madison, Speeches in Congress, June 1789, as transcribed at constitution.org (the page is dated June 8, 1789; the House removal debate ran June 16-22, 1789, and his amendments were offered June 8)
